episodes.title: CrossFit, Cheating, MAGA & The Cult of Masculinity: How Fitness Became Political
episodes.description:
CrossFit became a global fitness empire, but the story behind its rise is about much more than workouts. We're looking at founder Greg Glassman, the controversies surrounding his leadership, allegations about his treatment of women, extravagant spending, and the eventual sale of the company.

But there's another conversation worth having: How did a fitness movement built around extreme discipline and physical toughness become so closely associated with America's increasingly aggressive brand of masculinity?

From the gym to the political stage, we're examining the intersection of power, privilege, misogyny, and the culture of hypermasculinity. And what happens when the men at the top are rarely held to the same standards they demand of everyone else?
